name: Lisabell Worth
source:
A secretary who works for the protagonist.

She is a cool beauty who is able to do her job and has an atmosphere of responsibility. She´s also the protagonist's legal tutor and tries hard to raise him correctly.

However, she actually has a crush on the main character and doesn't like it when other women get along with him, so she is jealous and sulks, and has a childish side.

Due to her meticulous nature, she tends to get frustrated by the stress of her work, as she is bothered by the unique and self-paced maids. Therefore, she is always hungry to have sex with the main character, and although she is usually serious, when they are alone, she is willing to serve him.

''It can't be helped... I'm the secretary here, I'll have to take off one skin".
